subject.title: feat(mattermost): auto-engage on replies to the bot's own thread

question: Should Mattermost reply-to-bot thread-root auto-engagement ship default-on, with no config option, once exact-head checks are acceptable?
rationale: This changes when Mattermost sends agent replies in rooms that currently rely on mention/onchar gating, and that is an intentional product and upgrade-safety choice rather than a mechanical code defect.

options.title: Accept Default-On Parity
options.body: Merge after exact-head checks and either a live Mattermost roundtrip or an explicit maintainer waiver, matching Slack/Telegram reply-to-bot behavior.

options.title: Request Opt-In Policy
options.body: Ask for a narrower setting or policy gate before changing existing Mattermost mention/onchar behavior.

options.title: Pause For Broader Thread Policy
options.body: Hold this PR until Mattermost participated-thread and reply-to-bot behavior are reviewed as one channel policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Default-On Parity
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head checks and either a live Mattermost roundtrip or an explicit maintainer waiver, matching Slack/Telegram reply-to-bot behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current Mattermost participated-thread behavior and this follow-up, so they have the clearest implementation context for the maintainer choice.
